            COALESCE(esc.cppib_party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,
            COALESCE(exc2.exchange_name, ' ') as exchange_name,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(esc.esm_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,
            COALESCE(und.abor_security_number, '') as secno_underly
        from holdings.scd_holdings_main hold
                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esc on hold.business_date = date_format(esc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(esc.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join holdings.repo_holdings_details repo on hold.business_date = date_format(repo.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and hold.scd_holding_key_id = repo.id_source_holding
                 left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on hold.business_date = mp.business_date and hold.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
                 left join reference.scd_portfolio port on hold.portfolio_id = port.portfolio_id and hold.business_date = port.business_date
                 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on hold.business_date = date_format(asi.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join party.party party on cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esc.cppib_party_id and date_format(party.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join (select id_cppib_party, max(party_group) as party_group
                            from reference.scd_party_issuer iss
                                     join final_dates fd on iss.business_date = fd.business_date
                            group by id_cppib_party) iss
                           on iss.id_cppib_party = cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar)
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes iss_country on iss_country.country_code = party.domicile_country_code
            and iss_country.business_date = party.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes trade_country on trade_country.country_code = esc.esm_country_code
            and date_format(trade_country.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes port_curr on date_format(port_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and port_curr.currency_code = port.portfolio_currency
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes local_curr on date_format(local_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date
                 left join
             (select exchange_id, max(exchange_name) as exchange_name
              from (select mic as exchange_id, max(mic_name) as exchange_name from reference.reference_exchange_codes exc where
                  date_format(exc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2025-05-06' group by mic
                    union
                    select exchange_code as exchange_id, max(vendor_exchange_name) as exchange_name
                    from reference.reference_exchange_codes_map
                    group by exchange_code
                    union
                    select 'INT' as exchange_code, 'Internal' as exchange_name)
              group by exchange_id
             ) as exc2
             on exc2.exchange_id = sec.abor_exchange_id
        where (hold.balance_nominal_number != 0 or
                hold.balance_nominal_number_unsettled != 0 or
                hold.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency != 0 or

                hold.next_dividend_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency != 0)) T LIMIT 0

	select

		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc

		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage

			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc

		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name

		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name

				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from

	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

			  business_date

				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

		, case

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency

		from (
			select

				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc

				, year_month

				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM

		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)

		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 05:18:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 20:17:59'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

        holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended lth
        left join holdings.scd_holdings_main mh on lth.parent_holding_key = mh.scd_holding_key_id and date(mh.business_date) = lth.business_date
        -- replace? left for contract size: this is best joined on the parent holding
        -- we need scd_securities for the sec type and contract size for now
        left join reference.scd_securities scd_par_sec on scd_par_sec.abor_security_number = mh.abor_security_number and date(scd_par_sec.business_date) = date(mh.business_date) 
        left join asset.enterprise_security eem_par_sec on eem_par_sec.enterprise_security_id = lth.parent_enterprise_security_id and eem_par_sec.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        -- nonsense
        left join asset.enterprise_security eem_und_sec on eem_und_sec.enterprise_security_id = lth.enterprise_security_id and eem_und_sec.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        -- should not need this
        --left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on cast(scd_par_sec.cppib_sec_id as int) = asi.cppib_sec_id and asi.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
        left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mh.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id and date(mp.business_date) =date(mh.business_date)
        -- portfolio_id not available in ma_holding_lookthrough
        left join reference.scd_portfolio por on por.portfolio_id  = mh.portfolio_id and date(por.business_date)=date(mh.business_date)
        left join finance_accounting.scd_unitization uacpp on mp.pool_account_code = uacpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code and uacpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' and uacpp.business_date =  mp.business_date
        left join finance_accounting.scd_unitization ubcpp on mp.pool_account_code = ubcpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code and ubcpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' and ubcpp.business_date = mp.business_date
        left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif on lth.business_date = date(pif.business_date) and lth.id_model_portfolio = pif.model_portfolio and pif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
        left join (SELECT trs_g.id_instrument, max(trs_g.trade_date) last_transaction_date,
                    max(trs_g.maturity_date) trs_maturity_date 
                    from trades_deals.trs_trades trs_g
                    where trs_g.business_date = date'2025-06-02'
                    group by trs_g.id_instrument) trs on lth.parent_security_number = trs.id_instrument
left join party.enterprise_party eem_issr on eem_issr.enterprise_party_id = lth.enterprise_party_id and eem_issr.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
left join party.enterprise_party eem_issr_ult_par on eem_issr_ult_par.enterprise_party_id = eem_issr.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id and eem_issr_ult_par.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
left join reference.reference_country_codes und_rcoi on und_rcoi.country_code = eem_und_sec.esm_incorp_country_code and und_rcoi.business_date = date(lth.business_date)
where lth.business_date = date'2025-06-02'
    -- filter synthetics
    and COALESCE(lth.parent_security_type_name, '') not in ('Synthetic Credit Index','Synthetic Equity Index','Synthetic Fixed Income Index')
    and por.portfolio_group_id in('CPPIB GROUP','SUPPLEMENTARY','BCPP','ACPP')

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

with Murex as
(select distinct i.business_date pricedate
        , i.system analytics_source
        , i.trade_id trade_id  
    	, i.instrument_type instrumenttype 
    	, i.instrument_sub_type instrumentsubtype 
    	, i.trade_strategy_name murex_strategy_code    
        , i.trading_portfolio_code model_portfolio
    	, i.id_instrument cpp_secid
	    , i.instrument_name sec_name
    	, s.abor_country_of_security country
    	, i.par_nominal_currency as ccy
    	, i.rate_type as cpn_type
    	, case when i.premium=0 then i.cap_rate else i.premium end  as cpn_rate
    	, i.instrument_maturity_date maturity_date
    	, i.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad fx_rate
        , i.remaining_capital face_local
        , i.remaining_capital * i.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad face_cad
        , i.market_value fair_value_local
        , i.market_value * i.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad fair_value_cad
        , i.current_clean_price gl_price
        , s.abor_security_number scd_id
        , s.scd_security_id source_system_id
        , s.abor_security_number isin
    from trades_deals.collaterized_loan_obligation_trades i
        left join holdings.scd_holdings_main s
            on s.cppib_sec_id=i.id_instrument
            and s.security_group_id in ('COL OBLIG')
    where i.run_description in ('EOD','EOM')
    	and i.instrument_id_type = 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
),

SCD as
(select distinct cast(s.business_date as date) pricedate
        , 'SCD' analytics_source
        , null trade_id  
    	, s.security_group_name instrumenttype 
    	, s.abor_security_type_name instrumentsubtype 
    	, null murex_strategy_code

MUREX_SCD_UNION as
(
select * from MUREX m
    union
select * from SCD s
    where s.cpp_secid not in (select distinct cpp_secid from MUREX)
),

TRUSTED as
(
    select u.pricedate business_date
	, m.sa_sub_strategy_name level_1
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_2
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_3
	, m.model_portfolio_name reporting_name
	, coalesce(u.instrumenttype, a.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) instrumenttype
	, coalesce(u.instrumentsubtype, a.sec_typ_lvl2_nm) instrumentsubtype
	, coalesce(p.party_name, b.issuer_name) issuer 
	, coalesce(u.sec_name, b.instrument_name, a.sec_desc) sec_name 
	, coalesce(u.ccy, b.currency_code, a.crncy) ccy 
	, coalesce(u.cpn_type, b.coupon_type) cpn_type 
	, u.cpn_rate cpn_rate 
    , case when u.maturity_date is not null then cast(u.maturity_date as varchar)
        when b.maturity_date is not null then cast(b.maturity_date as varchar)
	    else a.maturity_date end maturity
    , coalesce(u.country, b.country_code, a.cntry) country
	, ttt.translation region
	, coalesce(g.name, 'Other') sector
	, tt.translation rating
	, tr.translation rank 
	, 'LIQUID' liquidity
	, u.face_local face_local 
	, u.fair_value_local fair_value_local
	, u.fair_value_cad fair_value_cad
	, null total_exposure
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytm
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytw
	, /*DAY2*/ null stw
	, /*DAY2*/ null rates_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01_cad
	, /*DAY2*/ null credit_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01_cad
	, u.gl_price gl_price
	, null alf_sector
    , u.model_portfolio model_portfolio 
	, /*DAY2*/ null ci_sector
	, u.scd_id scd_id
	, null libor_floor
	, u.cpp_secid cpp_secid 
	, case when b.coupon_type='FLOATING' then b.coupon_rate + b.float_spread/1000
	        else b.coupon_rate end all_in_cpn 
	, gg.name industry_group
	, coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin) isin
	, u.analytics_source analytics_source
	, /*OUT*/ null carry
	, u.face_cad face_cad	
	, concat(coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin), ' ', a.market_sector_desc ) bloombergcode
	, md.translation rawRating  --Moody
     , t.translation warf
     , tttt.translation region_alt1 
     , concat(tttt.translation,'|',tt.translation) credit_char
     , u.trade_id trade_id  
	 , u.murex_strategy_code murex_strategy_code
	 , u.fx_rate fx_rate
     , u.analytics_source source_system 
     , u.source_system_id source_system_id 
     , now() extract_date 
    from MUREX_SCD_UNION u
        left join asset.asset_bonds b
            on u.cpp_secid = cast(b.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                and u.pricedate = b.business_date
        left join reference.scd_model_portfolio m
            on u.model_portfolio = m.model_portfolio_id
                and u.pricedate = date(m.business_date)
    	left join asset.asset_security_identifiers a
    		on u.pricedate=a.business_date 
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(a.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    	left join party.party p
    	    on a.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
    	        and a.business_date = p.business_date
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications g
    		on a.business_date=g.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=g.cppib_party_id 
    			and g.level_type='SECTOR'
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications gg
    		on a.business_date=gg.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=gg.cppib_party_id 
    			and gg.level_type='INDUSTRY_GROUP'
    	left join asset.asset_security_ratings r
    		on u.pricedate=r.business_date
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(r.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    			and r.rating_agency='CPPIB'
        Left join TRANSLATE_WARF t ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(t.phrase)			
        Left join TRANSLATE_MOODYS md  ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(md.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_RATING tt ON upper(md.translation)=upper(tt.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_REGION ttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(ttt.phrase)
        Left join TRANSLATE_ALT_REGION tttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(tttt.phrase) 
        Left join TRANSLATE_RANK tr ON upper(coalesce(b.collateral_type,'Other')) = upper(tr.phrase)
)

TRUSTED as
(
    select u.pricedate business_date
	, m.sa_sub_strategy_name level_1
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_2
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_3
	, m.model_portfolio_name reporting_name
	, coalesce(u.instrumenttype, a.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) instrumenttype
	, coalesce(u.instrumentsubtype, a.sec_typ_lvl2_nm) instrumentsubtype
	, coalesce(p.party_name, b.issuer_name) issuer 
	, coalesce(u.sec_name, b.instrument_name, a.sec_desc) sec_name 
	, coalesce(u.ccy, b.currency_code, a.crncy) ccy 
	, coalesce(u.cpn_type, b.coupon_type) cpn_type 
	, u.cpn_rate cpn_rate 
    , case when u.maturity_date is not null then cast(u.maturity_date as varchar)
        when b.maturity_date is not null then cast(b.maturity_date as varchar)
	    else a.maturity_date end maturity
    , coalesce(u.country, b.country_code, a.cntry) country
	, ttt.translation region
	, coalesce(g.name, 'Other') sector
	, tt.translation rating
	, tr.translation rank 
	, 'LIQUID' liquidity
	, u.face_local face_local 
	, u.fair_value_local fair_value_local
	, u.fair_value_cad fair_value_cad
	, null total_exposure
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytm
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytw
	, /*DAY2*/ null stw
	, /*DAY2*/ null rates_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01_cad
	, /*DAY2*/ null credit_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01_cad
	, u.gl_price gl_price
	, null alf_sector
    , u.model_portfolio model_portfolio 
	, /*DAY2*/ null ci_sector
	, u.scd_id scd_id
	, null libor_floor
	, u.cpp_secid cpp_secid 
	, case when b.coupon_type='FLOATING' then b.coupon_rate + b.float_spread/1000
	        else b.coupon_rate end all_in_cpn 
	, gg.name industry_group
	, coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin) isin
	, u.analytics_source analytics_source
	, /*OUT*/ null carry
	, u.face_cad face_cad	
	, concat(coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin), ' ', a.market_sector_desc ) bloombergcode
	, md.translation rawRating  --Moody
     , t.translation warf
     , tttt.translation region_alt1 
     , concat(tttt.translation,'|',tt.translation) credit_char
     , u.trade_id trade_id  
	 , u.murex_strategy_code murex_strategy_code
	 , u.fx_rate fx_rate
     , u.analytics_source source_system 
     , u.source_system_id source_system_id 
     , now() extract_date 
    from MUREX_SCD_UNION u
        left join asset.asset_bonds b
            on u.cpp_secid = cast(b.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                and u.pricedate = b.business_date
        left join reference.scd_model_portfolio m
            on u.model_portfolio = m.model_portfolio_id
                and u.pricedate = date(m.business_date)
    	left join asset.asset_security_identifiers a
    		on u.pricedate=a.business_date 
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(a.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    	left join party.party p
    	    on a.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
    	        and a.business_date = p.business_date
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications g
    		on a.business_date=g.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=g.cppib_party_id 
    			and g.level_type='SECTOR'
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications gg
    		on a.business_date=gg.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=gg.cppib_party_id 
    			and gg.level_type='INDUSTRY_GROUP'
    	left join asset.asset_security_ratings r
    		on u.pricedate=r.business_date
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(r.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    			and r.rating_agency='CPPIB'
        Left join TRANSLATE_WARF t ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(t.phrase)			
        Left join TRANSLATE_MOODYS md  ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(md.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_RATING tt ON upper(md.translation)=upper(tt.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_REGION ttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(ttt.phrase)
        Left join TRANSLATE_ALT_REGION tttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(tttt.phrase) 
        Left join TRANSLATE_RANK tr ON upper(coalesce(b.collateral_type,'Other')) = upper(tr.phrase)
)

where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_uat.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
and group_name = 'SDFE_Raw_Rating_Mapping'),

TRANSLATE_REGION as
(select phrase, translation from reference_uat.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_uat.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
and group_name = 'SDFE_CO_CI_Region_Def_Mapping'),

TRANSLATE_ALT_REGION as
(select phrase, translation from reference_uat.ci_sentry_translation_groups     
where business_date = (select max(business_date) as business_date from reference_uat.ci_sentry_translation_groups)
and group_name = 'SDFE_CO_Region_Alt1_Mapping'),

MUREX_SCD_UNION as
(
select * from MUREX m
    union
select * from SCD s
    where s.cpp_secid not in (select distinct cpp_secid from MUREX)
),

TRUSTED as
(
    select u.pricedate business_date
	, m.sa_sub_strategy_name level_1
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_2
	, concat('Public ', m.regional_classification_code) level_3
	, m.model_portfolio_name reporting_name
	, coalesce(u.instrumenttype, a.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) instrumenttype
	, coalesce(u.instrumentsubtype, a.sec_typ_lvl2_nm) instrumentsubtype
	, coalesce(p.party_name, b.issuer_name) issuer 
	, coalesce(u.sec_name, b.instrument_name, a.sec_desc) sec_name 
	, coalesce(u.ccy, b.currency_code, a.crncy) ccy 
	, coalesce(u.cpn_type, b.coupon_type) cpn_type 
	, u.cpn_rate cpn_rate 
    , case when u.maturity_date is not null then cast(u.maturity_date as varchar)
        when b.maturity_date is not null then cast(b.maturity_date as varchar)
	    else a.maturity_date end maturity
    , coalesce(u.country, b.country_code, a.cntry) country
	, ttt.translation region
	, coalesce(g.name, 'Other') sector
	, tt.translation rating
	, tr.translation rank 
	, 'LIQUID' liquidity
	, u.face_local face_local 
	, u.fair_value_local fair_value_local
	, u.fair_value_cad fair_value_cad
	, null total_exposure
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytm
	, /*DAY2*/ null ytw
	, /*DAY2*/ null stw
	, /*DAY2*/ null rates_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01
	, /*DAY2*/ null ir01_cad
	, /*DAY2*/ null credit_duration
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01
	, /*DAY2*/ null cs01_cad
	, u.gl_price gl_price
	, null alf_sector
    , u.model_portfolio model_portfolio 
	, /*DAY2*/ null ci_sector
	, u.scd_id scd_id
	, null libor_floor
	, u.cpp_secid cpp_secid 
	, case when b.coupon_type='FLOATING' then b.coupon_rate + b.float_spread/1000
	        else b.coupon_rate end all_in_cpn 
	, gg.name industry_group
	, coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin) isin
	, u.analytics_source analytics_source
	, /*OUT*/ null carry
	, u.face_cad face_cad	
	, concat(coalesce(u.isin,b.isin, a.isin), ' ', a.market_sector_desc ) bloombergcode
	, md.translation rawRating  --Moody
     , t.translation warf
     , tttt.translation region_alt1 
     , concat(tttt.translation,'|',tt.translation) credit_char
     , u.trade_id trade_id  
	 , u.murex_strategy_code murex_strategy_code
	 , u.fx_rate fx_rate
     , u.analytics_source source_system 
     , u.source_system_id source_system_id 
     , now() extract_date 
    from MUREX_SCD_UNION u
        left join asset.asset_bonds b
            on u.cpp_secid = cast(b.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                and u.pricedate = b.business_date
        left join reference.scd_model_portfolio m
            on u.model_portfolio = m.model_portfolio_id
                and u.pricedate = date(m.business_date)
    	left join asset.asset_security_identifiers a
    		on u.pricedate=a.business_date 
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(a.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    	left join party.party p
    	    on a.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
    	        and a.business_date = p.business_date
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications g
    		on a.business_date=g.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=g.cppib_party_id 
    			and g.level_type='SECTOR'
    	left join party.party_gics_classifications gg
    		on a.business_date=gg.business_date 
    			and a.cppib_party_id=gg.cppib_party_id 
    			and gg.level_type='INDUSTRY_GROUP'
    	left join asset.asset_security_ratings r
    		on u.pricedate=r.business_date
    			and u.cpp_secid=cast(r.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    			and r.rating_agency='CPPIB'
        Left join TRANSLATE_WARF t ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(t.phrase)			
        Left join TRANSLATE_MOODYS md  ON upper(r.rating_value)=upper(md.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_RATING tt ON upper(md.translation)=upper(tt.phrase)	
        Left join TRANSLATE_REGION ttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(ttt.phrase)
        Left join TRANSLATE_ALT_REGION tttt ON upper(coalesce(u.country,a.cntry))=upper(tttt.phrase) 
        Left join TRANSLATE_RANK tr ON upper(coalesce(b.collateral_type,'Other')) = upper(tr.phrase)
)
